content: {"episode_id":"ep-05031","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Given the documented personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management. The clinical indication note in the submitted records supports the medical necessity of this monitoring service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
